top_signals.title: Remy Cointreau’s China Inventory Issues Outweigh Sales Jump
top_signals.summary: Remy Cointreau SA reported higher stockpiles in China during its fiscal second quarter, raising concerns about the resilience of a sales rebound in a key market for the Cognac maker.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
